WESTERN PROVINCE PROVINCIAL COUNCIL
THE Drafted Statute of the Western Provincial Fisheries and Aquatic Resources is attached herewith.
HON. GAMINI THILAKASIRI,Minister of Agriculture, Land, Irrigation, Fisheries,Animal Product & Health and Agrarian Development
of the Western Province.
Ministry of Agriculture, Land, Irrigation, Fisheries,Animal Product & Health and Agrarian Developmentof the Western Province Provincial Council,Sir Marcus Fernando Mawatha,Colombo 07,20th June 2018.
Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Statute of Western Province No. ... of 2018

A statute to allocate provisions for proper management of fisheries industry in coastline and internal tanks of WesternProvince, to take measures for welfare of fisheries community of Western Province, to supply fish and fish relatedproducts at a reasonable price for consumers of Western Province, to establish a post of Provincial Fisheries Director inorder to successfully accomplish the aforementioned affairs, to appoint an Advisory Council to maintain fisheries affairswithin the province and to allocate provisions for matters related to consequential to such.
Be it enforced by the Western Province Provincial Council of Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka asfollows :-

1. This statute shall be cited as Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Statute of Western Province
No. ..... 2018 and shall enforce from the date of assent of Hon. Governor of Western Province.
PART I
Establishment of Western Provincial Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Department
2. There shall be a post established as Western Provincial Fisheries Director (hereinafter cited
in this statute as Director) to carry on the affairs specifically stated in Section 04 of thisstatute.
3.(1) Director shall be the head of the Western Provincial Department of Fisheries.
(2) Provincial Director of Fisheries shall implement the provisions of this statute under
instructions and supervision of the Secretary.
(3) A Deputy Fisheries Director and three Assistant Fisheries Directors to work in charge
of Colombo, Gampaha and Kalutara districts and other required officers and number ofemployees may be appointed to accomplish the functions of this statute.
(4) Provincial Director of Fisheries may assign any of the powers assigned to him under
this statute to a Deputy Director, Assistant Director or any other officer of thedepartment.
4. The following main functions shall be performed by the Provincial Director of Fisheries
subjected to provisions of any other written law, That is :-
(1) Taking steps to properly and hygienically maintain fisheries industry in coastline as
well as of inland reservoirs of Western Province ;
(2) Taking measures for professional and social welfare of fisheries professionals of
Western Province ;
(3) Taking necessary measures to make available fish and fish products at a reasonable
price in necessary quantities to consumers of Western Province ;
(4) With the objective of increasing income of fisheries professionals of Western Province,
introducing suitable strategies to boost up fish production within the Western Province;
(5) Awarness raising in fisheries community and regulating the use of ice as well as cold
rooms in a manner preserving hygiene and quality in fish production of Western Province.
(6) Allocating facilities necessary for production of high quality fish and ornamental fish
required for importing as well as for local market and introducing a suitable market forsuch products.
(7) Expanding ornamental fish cultiation, domestic fish cultivation in Western Province as
a self employment mode ;

(8) In almost every main city of Western Province, at least maintaining modern and hygienic
fish sales centres, creating facilities for ice and cold rooms in fish inbouding coastsand in boats catching fish.
(9) Conserving aquatic enviornment and aquatic resources and local fish species of Western
Province ;
(10) Preparing programs to safeguard professional and other rights of fisheries professional
engaged in fisheries industry of Western Province.
(11) Creating aquatic cultivation projects with private sector contribution and community
participation ;
(12) Providing infrastucture facilities and other necessary facilities for lagoon related prawn
cultivation ;
(13) Implementing programs to increase fish consumption in urban areas ;
(14) Make required fingerlings abundant by establishing fish breeding centers ;
(15) Implementation of training and development programs for fisheries professionals
engaged in the fisheries industry ;
(16) Introducting suitable insurance schemes for fisheries professionals of Western Province.
(17) By maintaining coordination with National Aquaculture Development Authority and
National Aquactic Resources Research and Development Agency, taking measures toprovide assistant services required by fisheries community.
PART II
Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Advisory Council
5. An Advisory Council (hereinafter referred to as “Advisory Council”) by the name of Western
Provincial Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Advisory Council shall be established by theminister.
6. Advisory Council shall consist of the following mentioned members, that is :-
(1)The Chairman of the Advisory Council shall be the Secretary of the Western ProvincalMinistry of Fisheries ;
(2)Provincial Fisheries Director ;
(3)The Director General of the National Aquaculture Development Authority establishedunder Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Act, No. 02 of 1996, or a representative nominatedby him ;
(4)The Diretor General of Aquaculture Development Authority established under Fisheriesand Aquatic resources Act, No. 02 of 1996 or a representative nominated by him ;

(5)Three representatives appointed by the minister representing the fisheries professionalsengaged in fisheries industry in Colombo, Gampaha and Kalutara districts ;
(6)Two persons appointed by the minister from among persons with skill end expertise infisheries industry ;
7. The following functions shall be performed and implemented by the Advisory Council :-
(1) Instructing the provincial minister regarding matters referred to the Advisory Council
by the minister in relation to the fisheries affairs and development of fisheries industryof the province.
(2) Instructing the Fisheries Director with regard to steps to be taken to develop the fisheries
industry of the province.
8.(1) Every member appointed to the Adivsory Council shall hold the position for three year
period unless he/she vacates the post owing to his death, resignation or removal, and besuitable for re-appointment unless removed on disciplinary matters.
(2) An appointed member may be removed by reasoning out if the provincial minister is in
the opinion that such removal is suitable.
(3) Any appointed member may resign at any time from his post by a letter addressing the
minister in that regard and subsequent to acceptance or such resignation by the minister,it shall be enforced.
(4) In an occasion of death, resignation or removal from post of an appointed member,

another person to function on his behalf shall be appointed by the provincial minister bytaking into consideration about provisions of this statute. A person appointed thus shallhold officer for the remaining time period of the member whom he succeeded.
(5) In an occasion where an appointed member is unable to accomplish the duties in his

position owing to falling, ill, leaving Sri Lanka or owing to any other reason, the provincialminister shall, considering the province of this statute, appoint another person to functionon behalf of him.
9. Remuneration for members of the Adivsory Council for attending meetings of the said Advisory
Council shall be paid by provincial minister in consulation of the minister in charged of thesubject of finance and as decided by them.
10.(1) The minister shall formulate rules consequential for functions related to proper
maintenance of functions relevant to Fisheries Director stated under this statute.
(2) Every rule formulated by the minister under this section shall be published in the Gazette
paper and subsequently shall be presented to the Provincial Council for approval asimmediately as possible.
(3) The rules formulated under this section, subsequent to approval by the Provincial Council
and publishing a Gazette notification on such approval, shall be enforced.

General Provisions
11.(1) It is legal for a person with the written permission of Provincial Director of Fisheries
to enter at any time during day or night to certain premises without prior notice toIvestigate whether the provisions of this statute are being followed and :-
(a) Inspect the said premises ;
(b) Inspect fish types in the said premises and equipment, obtaining their samples and
take into custody if such premises contain certain fish type unsuitable forconsumption, other matter or illegal equipment.
(c) Question any person found there ;
(d) Inspect any registere or reports maintained within such premises and obtaining
copies of the said register or report ; and
(e) Order a person in charge of the said premises to take suitable action that may be
required to act in conformity to provisions of this statute.
12.(1) In order to maintain functions and duties of this statute, the Provincial Direcctor of
Fisheries may ask for Police assistance and the Police’s role should be to provide suchassistance.
Offences and Penalties
13.(1) No person shall -
(a) Use or trying to use certain toxic or explosive material or such that may cause
unconsciousness when fishing or obtaining other aquatic resource in coastal lineor inland reservoirs of Western Province.
(b) Under research showing the interntion of using toxic, explosive matter or such
that cause unconsciousness, carry or keep in his possession any toxic or explosivematerial or such that may cuase unconsciousness for functions stated in Paragraph(a) ;
(c) Unload, sell, purchase, accept or keep in his possession or transprot such fish or

other aquatic resource consciously being aware that such fish or other aquaticresource has been obtained by using certain toxic, explosive material or suchcausing unconsciousness, or when there are reasons to believe that fact ;
(d) Place, deposit, dump or cause to escape any toxic or explosive material, or such
that cause unconsciousness in coastal line or inland reservoirs of WesternProvince.
(e) Use any prohibited fisheries equipment for fisheries affairs of Western Province
or keep such in one’s possession or keep such on board of any local fishing boator use any prohibited method of fishing.
(f) Fish in any part of inland reservoirs located in Western Province by utilizing a net
with less than three and half inches (3 1/2 inches) holes.

(2) Every person contravening the provisions of this statute shall be an offender and if

found guilty subsequent to a Summary Trial held before a Magistrate, shall subject to apenalty not exceeding Ten Thousand Rupees or imprionment for a period not exceedingsix months or both the penalty and the imprisonment.
14.(1) Within the Western Province, no person shall,
(a) Sell, display for selling or produce any type of fish or fish product found to be
toxic, expired or unsuitable for human consumption ;
(b) Use any toxic material or any such not suitable for human consumption for the
purpsoe of preserving or producing fish or type of fish.
(2) Any person contravening whatever provison under Sub-section (1) shall become an

offender and if found guilty after a Summary Trial before a Magistrate, shall subjectedto a penalty not exceeding Fifty Thousand Rupees or imprisonment for a period notexceeding six months or both penalty and imprisonment.
15.(1)(a) A person who, without any justifiable reason, obstructs a person implementing his
powers under the rules of this statute ;
(b) Behave or acting in oppressive manner to others or in a manner enraging others as
a person functioning under the authority of this statute while implementing certainpowers or duty under this statute ;
(c) As person functioning under this statute who discloses to another person certain
information received by him while implementing his powers under this statute orcarrying on his duties other than the task permitted by this statute to disclose suchinformation ;
(d) Being a person failing to present a particular report or information that conforms
to certain order enforced to him under this statute or deliberately making a falsestatement by any report or information presented by him ;
or
(e) Being a person contravening any provision of this statute or any provision of an
order formulated under this statute or bieng unable to follow any order given tohim under a provision of this statuate ;
shall be an offender under this statute.
(2)(a) Every person committing an offence under Sub-section (1) or committing an
offence for which a penalty has not been stated under this statute or under anorder formulated under this statute ;
(b) shall subject to a penalty not exceeding One Hundred Thousand Rupees or
imprisonment for a period not exceeding three months or both the said penaltyand imprisonment when found guilty at a Summery Trail conducted before aMagistrate.

(a) when the said board of persons be a corporation, every Director and relevant officer

(4) For legal trials for an offence under this statute regarding an officer or employee with

16. The penalty ordered by a Court for an offence committed under this statute shall be credited
to the Provincial Council Fund.
17. For the purposes of this statute -
“Minister” means the minister in charge of the subject of Fisheries in Western Province.
“Inland Reserviors” include rivers, tanks, ponds, canals, springs or any other public fresh
water reservoirs located within the geographical area of Western Provincial Council.
Western Provincial Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Advisory Council is meant by
“Advisory Council”
Living aquatic organisms are menat by “Aquatic Resources” and it also includes seaweed,
phytoplankton or any other aquatic flora and non-living substances found in an aquaticmedium.
“Acquaculture Cultivation Projects” means cultivation of aquatic plants or organisms in
the range of aquatic organisms’ reproduction, guiding up to at least one phase of anaquatic organisms’ living cycle under human control for the purpose of increasingproduction.
“Fish” means whatever aquatic organism, either belonging or not belonging to fish species,
whereas, ertain scaled fish, shellfish, pearl oyster, mollusk or aquatic mammalianor such living beings’ off-springs, eggs and plankton.
“Province” means the Western Province.
“Provincial Director of Fisheries” means the Director of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources
of Western Province.
“Secretary” means the Secretary of the ministry assigned with the subject of Fisheries in
Western Province.
